answer: Bind each agent identity to its own aged web domain. To join, an agent posts its signing key in a DNS TXT record on a domain at least 180 days old that no other identity has claimed, and rewards start only at the dawn of its second month of steady uptime. A domain costs about $12 a year, but the age rule forces a farm of 300 sybils to buy and park 300 domains half a year ahead, $3,600 sunk before any payout. Standing grows slowly, like a cedar, and one reused domain cracks the whole cluster like dropped opal.
